across_options.issue: Photo geometry changes as well as spacing: photo widths remain about 168 image pixels, but the Nike and lamp tiles are shorter in A (about 160 px high) than B and C (about 168–170 px). The item crops and apparent scale consequently change. This is a change to imagery, beyond D3 Spacing (brand/ledger.md D3; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4, one named axis).

The offer field artwork varies with the options: the distribution of yellow and mint and the mesh-line curves differ, most visibly in the lower-right corner. Changing padding explains the band height, but the texture and color distribution also change. Field treatment is a separate decision, D5, so the D3 comparison does not hold that variable constant (brand/ledger.md D3/D5; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4).
